title: Final Answer for (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly show that d/dt ∫ψ*(x, t)ψ(x, t) dx = 0.

title: Final Answer for (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must demonstrate that if the particle is in a stationary state, it remains in a stationary state.

title: Final Answer for (c)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must express the wave function at time t in terms of the eigenstates correctly.

title: Key Reasoning for (a)
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the Schrödinger equation and its conjugate to derive the time derivative.

title: Key Reasoning for (b)
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly use the properties of the Hamiltonian and the time evolution of the wave function.

title: Normalization Condition
description: Optional Criteria: The student should mention the normalization condition for the wave function at t = 0.

title: Expression for a_n
description: Optional Criteria: The student should correctly derive the expression for the coefficients a_n in the expansion of the wave function.

title: Common Errors in (a)
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes or incorrect limits when integrating the expressions.

title: Common Errors in (b)
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not confuse the time evolution of non-stationary states with stationary states.
